notes.title: Wait - 2.0 Update
notes.content:
For its 9 year anniversary, and in preparation for the release of 'Wait: The Patient', we updated 'Wait' to version 2.0, with lots of changes and improvements. 
If you are currently in the middle of a playthrough, it is safer to start the playthrough from the beginning, but it's not a necessity.

[h1]2.0 Changelog:[/h1]

[h2]Presentation:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Most ingame illustrations have been overhauled
[*] Title screen artworks have been overhauled
[*] Added voice for the audio logs you can find
[*] Added a day cycle animation
[*] Certain dialogue texts have been colored in for better character distinction
[*] Adjusted some SFX volumes
[*] Added atmopheric background noise in certain areas
[/list]

[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added an item overview that can be opened actively, and removed the item images on the side of the screen. 
[*] Added item illustrations for almost all items for that purpose.
[*] Disabled the infamous F12 key, that would restart your game immediately.
[/list]

[h2]Game Flow:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed the possibility of getting a different ending in the 1st playthrough, which led to some confusion and frustration.
[*] Changed the story flow in the 3rd night of the 2nd playthrough for more clarity.
[*] Added a new artwork to the chase in the 2nd night of the 1st playthrough.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that made it impossible to put the small lamp back in Riley's Basement.
[*] Added some missing text in the German version.
[*] Changed an event that would display German text in the French version, on the second interaction.
[*] Changed French text in the 3rd night of the 4th playthrough that was displayed in German.
[*] Fixed some typos in the English version,
[*] Fixed a bug where, under certain conditions, a wrong item would be given to the player.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the update and as always, feel free to join our Discord if you have any questions or feedback or issues: 
[url=https://discord.gg/qANEZejy8t]rest.less Games Discord Server[/url]

notes.title: Wait: The Patient - Store page live
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

after much consideration, we've decided to separate [i]The Patient[/i] from [i]Wait - Extended[/i], 
and turn it into its own game. 
There are multiple reasons for this decision. One being the technical issues that we briefly mentioned in a previous post, but also the fact that [i]The Patient[/i] has become a much bigger project than we first anticipated, and we feel like it deserves to be its own game.
So many people have put such wonderful work into the project, and we wouldn't want their work to be hidden within an 8 year old game. 
That way, it will also be possible for The Patient to have its own demo, achievements, trading cards, community hub, and so on. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10539605/085dd8b950af01042de39ee996e60b13eb607f57.png[/img]

That being said, we're super excited to release the Steam store page for [i]Wait: The Patien[/i]t today:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3081310/Wait_The_Patient/]Wait: The Patient Store Page[/url]

All Steam updates and news regarding the project will now be posted there, so make sure to follow and wishlist.

notes.title: Demo Release and development update
notes.content:
[h1]Demo Release[/h1]

Today we released a playable demo of 'Wait - Extended' that let's you play through the first nights of the main story. The demo version is already in version 2.0 which features some new artwork and some quality of life improvements. That being said, the full game still remains in v1.8, just to clear up any confusion should you play the full game after having played the demo. 

So, if you were uncertain about purchasing the game up until now, we invite you to play the demo and see for yourself if it's something for you. 
You can find it on the store page of the full game.

[h1]Development of 2.0[/h1]

As for the development of 2.0 'The Patient', we are nearing its end. While we said Q1 in our teaser, due to private matters, it didn't work out and we apologize. 
The story of the new side story has been completely developed and now we are implementing all sorts of polishing and extra elements that are still open, such as some optional side quests and secrets, as well as the artwork overhaul for the main story. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10539605/af9d92a2ce914c607e2244a1c56d32310271164b.png[/img]

We hope you are as excited for it as we are and stay tuned.

notes.title: Development Update and RPG Maker Festival
notes.content:
Hello, 

here's a very late "first update of the year". 

[h3]RPG Maker Festival 2024[/h3]

Before we dive into the current development, the [b]RPG Maker Festival 2024[/b] has started and we are participating with 'Wait - Extended'. So if you want to check out the game before the big update, you could get it now for a small discount. 
We also encourage you to check out the other great games participating in the festval.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/rpgmaker2024]RPG Maker Festival 2024[/url]


[h3]Development[/h3]

As for the development of '[i]The Patient[/i]' and version 2.0, we have finished almost all of the illustrations for the cutscenes and will start voice recording for the protagonist this week. We're very excited to put the visuals and audio together and eventually show you the results. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10539605/8d4d57c70da0bbe839ed61e91c7c57da24c9e259.png[/img]

As part of the update, the artwork from the base game will also be overhauled with the new style, which we will start, after all artwork for '[i]The Patient[/i]' has been created. 

On the coding side, we are trying to find a good fix for the infamous F12 key that, per engine default, restarts the game, instead of taking a Steam screenshot. Since this requires making changes to the core system, we're being very cautious with the whole plan. The last thing we want is to break what's already there.

As for the gameplay, sadly the game flow implementation isn't finished yet. The beginning of the year was wild and didn't leave as much time for development, as we had hoped. We are still aiming for our Q1 goal, though. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10539605/83b1278b74c791803f903f983197102fa92842af.jpg[/img]

[h3]A final note[/h3]

Lastly, a [b]little request[/b] - we're a very small passion driven team and although passion is an important factor when making games, it doesn't help if no one knows about your game. Marketing a game these days is like chewing on a tough piece of meat, and if you like our game and what we do, we'd like to kindly ask for your assistance in this regard. Share the trailer, our Steam page, our Discord with people you think are into that kind of game. Everything helps us get a little more traction. 

Thank you. 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/@rest.lessGames]rest.less Games YouTube[/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/qANEZejy8t]rest.less Games Discord[/url]

[url=https://twitter.com/thinkrestless]X / Twitter[/url]

notes.title: Winter Sale and Holidays
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 
as the holidays draw near, we are also preparing to spend a few days with the familiy. 
But not without letting you hear from us first.

The [b]Steam Winter Sale[/b] is upon us and if you feel the extra need for some holiday eeriness, you can grab [i]Wait - Extended[/i] for a discount. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10539605/f3ffb0b1dce1f24dbcdcfbce2b6dcad3579343f1.png[/img]

Apart from a little setback due to sickness, we made good progress. Because of the different setting and the possibility to talk to a lot of people (which you seldom do in the base game), we were faced with a different kind of story writing challenge and had quite a few design sessions with a lot of back and forth, before we settled on the final gameflow. 

As always and in tradition of games like these, there will be riddles and we try our best to make them as entertaining, challenging, and non-frustrating as we can. Some are optional and some are integrated in the story. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10539605/89814dd90cd25ed960ab35d1c3fe925da6a0201e.png[/img]

We wish you [b]Happy Holidays[/b] and look forward to next year's release of the update.

Cheers from the rest.less Games team.

notes.title: On The Patient's implementation and Save files
notes.content:
Here's our weekly update. 

This time we want to talk about how [i]The Patient[/i] is implemented mechanically. 
The main story of [i]Wait[/i] has a single save slot, which you continue directly out of the title menu.
[i]The Patient[/i] will have its own save slot, which means you could technically have 2 active saves simultaneously. 
Therefore, we decided to add a separate title screen for [i]The Patient[/i], from which you can continue (or start) your playthrough for this side story. 
That way, your save game for the main story is not affected by your progress in [i]The Patient[/i]. 
In light of this, the title screen for the main story will be reworked as well.

Again, for questions or chats, feel free to join our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/Qp2DPsB]https://discord.gg/Qp2DPsB[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10539605/7c645fc540cccadd50fe1befef0894c1e92bf866.png[/img]

notes.title: On 'Wait's timeline
notes.content:
Here's our weekly update.

The story that we're currently bringing to life, may not fit directly into the main story,
but it does fit into the timeline, which we are attempting to complete with this update.
There have been a variety of events surrounding the apartment in which 'Wait' takes place, 
dating back all the way to the 70s. 
With the coming content update, we will place the last piece into the timeline puzzle
and therefore cover all decades prior to the present events. 

Again, for questions or chats, feel free to join our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/Qp2DPsB ]https://discord.gg/Qp2DPsB [/url]

notes.title: On 'The Patient' time system
notes.content:
Here's our weekly update.

'The Patient' gives you more options to explore, as you have access to (almost) the entire premises. 
This is another example of contrast we wanted to create, compared to the base game, in which you are confined to specific maps. 

To add the element of time to exploration, 'The Patient' is separated into time phases. Much like in the base game, time will move on
after certain events, only this time slightly more granular. A day is split into several phases (for example morning, afternoon, evening) and
once you take certain actions, you will move into the next phase. That being said, within a time phase you can play at your own pace. Time will not
move on unless you want it to. Things will change in each phase (for example, people might be gone or be somewhere else), 
and sometimes what you do in one phase could influence the next. 
Hopefully you'll enjoy this simple time system.

As always, feel free to join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/Qp2DPsB


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10539605/b79509955adb1ae3655569aa7ca8b409b8a4c3f5.png[/img]

notes.title: On 'The Patient's protagonist
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10539605/61f0a43d53c221ccdbb3901e95124fc099674664.png[/img]
The new content for [i]Wait[/i] can be started individually and we did that for a few reasons: 
One of them being that the events cannot be placed into (or attached to) the main story line like we did with the other sidestories. 
And secondly, this is the first story that is not actively witnessed by our main protagonist from the base game. 
Therefore, '[i]The Patient[/i]' introduces a new protagonist that will be able to see things from a different perspective.

[i]Alice Fincher[/i] is a psychologist in a mental clinic, that players who've advanced further in the base game might know.
We wanted to bring a stark contrast to the pragmatic and somewhat apathetic demeanor of the main game's protagonist.
Dr. Fincher will bring a new perspective to the events of the game and we hope that you enjoy experiencing '[i]The Patient[/i]'s events together with her.

Again, for questions or chats, feel free to join our Discord: https://discord.gg/Qp2DPsB

notes.title: 1.5 Fixed candles, plates and minor things
notes.content:
There will be an update later today, which will include some small fixes, but also three bigger ones: 

- The candles in the 4th invocation's last night will now go out after a while, as they were intended to do, forcing you to fetch a new one in order to have light.

- The achievement "Regular" will now be triggered properly and not be influenced by repeated invocations.

- Some of you had trouble with the plates, when cleaning up the table. This works properly now.

- We included a version number in the lower right corner of the Controls screen, so you can make sure you're up to date.

notes.title: Minor Fixes and F12
notes.content:
We just uploaded a new version with some minor bugfixes. The update is so small you likely won't even noticed it updated at all. 
Furthermore we want to inform you that the F12 button WILL restart your game and will NOT take a screenshot. 
This is a famous problem our engine has, and we have not succeeded in fixing it. Please be aware of this, as the game will restart without saving. (Sorry, if it happened already) 

Humble regards
rest.less Games Team
